prior_summary: Role-relative object-goal binding with a shared two-object graph encoder, learned requested/predecessor role probabilities, and a FiLM-conditioned learned action-chunk epsilon diffusion model. Both object nodes remain available during predecessor disengagement. Because the fixed forward interface has no caller role-ID fields, a causal learned role resolver is supervised for the demonstrated red-then-blue order; there is no scripted action controller.
applicable_conditions: State-based top-down acquisition of the demonstrated 0.04 m cubes with Panda joint ordering, fixed world axes and table, and named object-goal pairing. Two causal 47-channel observations provide arm/finger positions and velocities, TCP and both object poses, and both goals. Covers initial red acquisition and recurrent blue acquisition entered while red is still descending above its pad, as well as open, closing and partly lifted overlap states. The external request must agree with the demonstrated red-first order because arbitrary caller role IDs cannot enter this interface.
termination_guidance: Continue through any predecessor lowering, opening and retreat and through requested-object acquisition. Usual transfer support is requested-object/TCP co-motion near z=0.28 m, approximately 0.0183 m per measured finger, and closed-gripper initial horizontal transport toward that object's goal. Width or height alone is insufficient evidence of grasp. The successor can take over earlier in the shared pickup overlap if it completes acquisition. These are qualitative skill-transfer cues, not task-success requirements or hard thresholds.
limitations: Successful demonstrations with small source jitter and fixed goals do not establish miss recovery, slip recovery, new obstacles, reversed task order or relocated robot bases. Learned role inference replaces unavailable externally supplied IDs and cannot honor a contrary nomination. Internal token permutation invariance and quaternion-sign invariance do not imply joint-space reflection or SE(3) equivariance. No IK, forward kinematics, image encoder, contact memory, dynamics constraint, collision guarantee or online success detector is implemented. Full task success remains exactly the supplied two-block placement contract.

config.segment_policy: Use every assigned expanded slice unchanged; no phase cropping, event clocks, occurrence indices or future observations in forward.

normalization.relative_spatial_scale: Coordinatewise maximum of supplied TCP, red-position and blue-position half ranges; shared by both object slots, goals and translation edges
normalization.action_representation: Unchanged shared affine normalization of seven absolute Panda joint targets and one gripper command

encoder.history_encoding: Current, previous, and current-minus-previous features; differences are per observation interval
encoder.rotation_encoding: Normalized wxyz quaternion converted to a 3x3 rotation matrix; also TCP-relative object rotation matrices
encoder.geometry: Absolute world positions and heights, absolute goals, object-goal and TCP-object world-axis translation edges, rotated cube XY containment margins and vertical goal margin, fixed world gravity
encoder.task_order_tag: Fixed first/second tag carried with the named object's pose and goal; no separate color-specific encoder weights
encoder.pooling: Robot node, requested-weighted object pool, predecessor-weighted pool including learned null embedding, symmetric object mean, null probability, and direct robot-history features

role_interface_adaptation.deployment: Learned soft requested distribution over two objects and predecessor distribution over two objects plus null; recomputed from causal observations only
role_interface_adaptation.training_label: If the current red rotated footprint fits its own pad in XY, requested=blue and predecessor=red; otherwise requested=red and predecessor=null. Height is deliberately ignored so a held descending predecessor is represented. This teacher is restricted to the assigned source slices and never selects deployment actions.
role_interface_adaptation.objective: Half the sum of requested and predecessor categorical cross entropies
role_interface_adaptation.augmentation: Independent 50 percent internal object-token swap per example during training, moving pose, goal, temporal features and task-order tag together; no joint, action or physical-world reflection

config.loss: Masked mean epsilon squared error plus 0.1 times the mean role cross entropy. No future-state auxiliary or observed-only penalty.

training_recipe.selection: Last EMA at the predeclared budget
